scenarios.expected: The canonical locale remains identical from embed start through callback and status.
Retries reuse the same canonical locale and create one accepted login state.
The flow fails without authorizing WordPress or CalorieApp.
Expired WordPress or backend state cannot be reused.
Backend retries retain the state-bound locale without repeating Xaman identity proof.
A mismatched state or locale is rejected before an authorization code is issued.
The initiating browser can claim the session once and receives the same locale.
Unsupported locale input resolves to English before state creation.
The twenty-first start inside sixty seconds is rejected with bounded retry guidance and creates no transaction.
A registered client with fifty retained unexpired transactions cannot allocate another transaction.
Database admission failure returns a retryable unavailable response and creates no partial transaction.
Pending status checks slow from five to ten to twenty seconds, transient failures back off to thirty seconds, and focus events cannot bypass a scheduled delay.
